title.zh: 卷十六 本紀第十六: 聖宗七
title.raw: 卷十六 本紀第十六: 聖宗七 Volume 16 Annals 16: Shengzong 7

sentences.zh: 聖宗七

translations.literal: Shengzong, Part Seven
translations.idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Seven

sentences.zh: 七年春正月甲辰，如達離山。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiachen day, went to Dali Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tonghe, on jiachen day of the first spring month the court went to Dali Mountain.

sentences.zh: 二月乙丑朔，拜日，如渾河。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the yichou new moon, worshipped the sun, went to Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou new moon of the second month the court worshipped the sun and went to Hun River.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑，命東北越裏篤、剖阿裏、奧裏米、蒲奴裏、鐵驪等五部歲貢貂皮六萬五千，馬三百。

translations.literal: In the third month, on xinchou day, ordered the five northeastern tribes Yuelidu, Pouali, Aolimi, Punuli, and Tieli to submit yearly tribute of sixty-five thousand sable pelts and three hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the third month the five northeastern tribes Yuelidu, Pouali, Aolimi, Punuli, and Tieli were ordered to submit yearly tribute of sixty-five thousand sable pelts and three hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 丙午，烏古部節度使蕭普達討叛命敵烈，滅之。

translations.literal: On bingwu day, Wugu tribal military commissioner Xiao Puda attacked the rebel Dilie and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Wugu tribal military commissioner Xiao Puda attacked the rebel Dilie and destroyed him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，拜日。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, worshipped the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court worshipped the sun.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，振川、饒二州饑。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, relieved famine in Chuan and Rao prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day famine relief was distributed in Chuan and Rao Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 辛未，振中京貧乏。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, relieved poverty in the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day poverty relief was distributed in the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，禁匿名書。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, forbade anonymous letters.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day anonymous letters were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以三司使呂德懋為樞密副使。

translations.literal: On renchen day, made Three Departments commissioner Lü Demao Privy Vice Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Three Departments commissioner Lü Demao was appointed Privy Vice Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬子，以蕭進忠為彰武軍節度使兼五州制置。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on renzi day, made Xiao Jinzhong Zhangwu Army military commissioner and concurrently commissioner for five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day of the intercalary month Xiao Jinzhong was appointed Zhangwu Army military commissioner and concurrently commissioner for five prefectures.

sentences.zh: 戊午，吐蕃王並裏尊奏，凡朝貢，乞假道夏國，從之。

translations.literal: On wuwu day, Tibetan king Binglizun memorialized that for all tributary missions he begged passage through Xia State; permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Tibetan king Binglizun memorialized that for all tributary missions he asked to pass through Xia territory; permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，皇子宗真封梁王，宗元永清軍節度使，宗簡右衛大將軍，宗願左驍衛大將軍，宗偉右衛大將軍，皇侄宗範昭義軍節度使，宗熙鎮國軍節度使，宗亮絳州節度使，宗弼濮州觀察使，宗奕曹州防禦使，宗顯、宗肅皆防禦使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin day, Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day of the fifth month Prince Zongzhen was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang; Zongyuan was made Yongqing Army military commissioner; Zongjian Right Guard senior general; Zongyuan Left Xiao Guard senior general; Zongwei Right Guard senior general; imperial nephew Zongfan Zhaoyi Army military commissioner; Zongxi Zhenguo Army military commissioner; Zongliang Jiang Prefecture military commissioner; Zongbi Pu Prefecture observation commissioner; Zongyi Cao Prefecture defense commissioner; and Zongxian and Zongsu both defense commissioners.

sentences.zh: 以張儉守司徒兼政事令。

translations.literal: Made Zhang Jian acting Minister over the Masses and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jian was appointed acting Minister over the Masses and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 六月丙申，品打魯瑰部節度使勃魯裏至鼻灑河，遇微雨，忽天地晦冥，大風飄四十三人飛旋空中，良久乃墮數里外。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on bingshen day, Pindaluogui tribal military commissioner Boluri reached Bisa River, encountered light rain, suddenly heaven and earth darkened, and a strong wind swept forty-three men spinning through the air; after a long time they fell several li away.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the sixth month Pindaluogui tribal military commissioner Boluri reached Bisa River in light rain when heaven and earth suddenly darkened; a strong wind swept forty-three men spinning through the air, and after a long time they fell several li away.

sentences.zh: 勃魯裏幸獲免。

translations.literal: Boluri fortunately escaped unharmed.
translations.idiomatic: Boluri fortunately escaped unharmed.

sentences.zh: 一酒壺在地反不移。

translations.literal: One wine jug on the ground did not move at all.
translations.idiomatic: One wine jug on the ground did not move at all.

sentences.zh: 八月丙午，行大射柳之禮。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingwu day, performed the great willow-shooting rite.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day of the eighth month the court performed the great willow-shooting rite.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以耶律留寧、吳守達使宋賀生辰，蕭高九、馬貽謀使宋賀正旦。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, appointed Yelü Liuning and Wu Shouda as envoys to Song to congratulate the birthday, and Xiao Gaojiu and Ma Yimou as envoys to Song to congratulate New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Yelü Liuning and Wu Shouda were appointed envoys to Song to congratulate the Emperor's birthday, and Xiao Gaojiu and Ma Yimou envoys to Song to congratulate New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 加平章蕭弘義開府儀同三司、尚父兼政事令。

translations.literal: Promoted Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Hongyi to Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors, Esteemed Father, and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Hongyi was promoted to Extraordinary Honorific Equal to Three Councillors, Esteemed Father, and concurrent Political Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲子，詔翰林待詔陳升寫《南征得勝圖》於上京五鸞殿。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiazi day, edict ordered Hanlin awaiting-draft Chen Sheng to paint the Victory Chart of the Southern Campaign at the Five Phoenix Hall in the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day of the seventh autumn month an edict ordered Hanlin awaiting-draft Chen Sheng to paint the Victory Chart of the Southern Campaign at the Five Phoenix Hall in the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，蒲奴裏部來貢。

translations.literal: On dingmao day, the Punuli tribe came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the Punuli tribe came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申朔，蒲昵國使奏本國與烏裏國封壤相接，數侵掠不寧，賜詔諭之，戊辰，詔內外官，因事受賕，事覺而稱子孫仆從者，禁之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the gengshen new moon, the Punii envoy memorialized that his country and Wuli country share borders and had repeatedly raided each other causing unrest; an edict was issued to instruct them. On wuchen day, edict ordered inner and outer officials who accept bribes in connection with matters and, when discovered, claim it was done by children or servants, forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen new moon of the ninth month the Punii envoy reported that his country and Wuli shared a border and had repeatedly raided each other; an edict was issued to instruct them. On wuchen day an edict forbade inner and outer officials who accept bribes and, when discovered, blame children or servants.

sentences.zh: 庚午，錄囚。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 括馬給東征軍。

translations.literal: Requisitioned horses for the eastern expedition army.
translations.idiomatic: Horses were requisitioned for the eastern expedition army.

sentences.zh: 是月，駐蹕土河川。

translations.literal: That month, halted at Tuhe River valley.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Tuhe River valley.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，名中京新建二殿曰延慶，曰永安。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, named two newly built halls in the Central Capital Yanqing and Yongan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month two newly built halls in the Central Capital were named Yanqing and Yongan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以順義軍節度使石用中為漢人行宮都部署。

translations.literal: On renyin day, made Shunyi Army military commissioner Shi Yongzhong Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Shunyi Army military commissioner Shi Yongzhong was appointed Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔以東平郡王蕭排押為都統，殿前都點檢蕭虛列為副統，東京留守耶律八哥為都監，伐高麗。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general, to campaign against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day an edict made Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Paiya supreme commander, Palace Front inspector general Xiao Xulie vice commander, and Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage inspector general for a campaign against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 仍諭高麗守吏，能率眾自歸者厚賞，堅壁相拒者追悔無及。

translations.literal: Also instructed Goryeo garrison officials that those who could lead their people to surrender would be richly rewarded, while those who held fast and resisted would regret too late.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo garrison officials were also told that those who led their people to surrender would be richly rewarded, while those who held fast would regret it too late.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，以呂德懋知吏部尚書，楊又玄知詳覆院，劉晟為霸州節度使，北府宰相劉慎行為彰武軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on renxu day, made Lü Demao to manage the Ministry of Personnel, Yang Youxuan to manage the Detailed Review Bureau, Liu Sheng Ba Prefecture military commissioner, and Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Shenxing Zhangwu Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the eleventh month Lü Demao was assigned to manage the Ministry of Personnel, Yang Youxuan the Detailed Review Bureau, Liu Sheng was made Ba Prefecture military commissioner, and Northern Chancellery chancellor Liu Shenxing Zhangwu Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，禁服用明金、縷金、貼金。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, forbade wearing bright gold, filigree gold, and gold leaf.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the wearing of bright gold, filigree gold, and gold leaf was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 戊子，幸中京。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, favored visit to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the court visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，宋遣呂夷簡、曹璋來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on dingyou day, Song sent Lü Yijian and Cao Zhang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day of the twelfth month Song sent Lü Yijian and Cao Zhang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 是月，蕭排押等與高麗戰於茶、陀二河，遼軍失利，天雲、右皮室二軍沒溺者眾，遙輦帳詳穩阿果達、客省使酌古、渤海詳穩高清明、天雲軍詳穩海裏等皆死之。

translations.literal: That month, Xiao Paiya and others fought Goryeo at the Cha and Tuo rivers; the Liao army was defeated, and many from the Tianyun and Right Pishi armies drowned; Yaolian tent xiangwen Aguoda, Reception Bureau commissioner Zhuogu, Bohai xiangwen Gao Qingming, Tianyun Army xiangwen Haili, and others all died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Paiya and others fought Goryeo at the Cha and Tuo rivers; the Liao army was defeated and many from the Tianyun and Right Pishi armies drowned; Yaolian tent xiangwen Aguoda, Reception Bureau commissioner Zhuogu, Bohai xiangwen Gao Qingming, Tianyun Army xiangwen Haili, and others all died.

sentences.zh: 放進士張克恭等三十七人及第。

translations.literal: Palace examination: jinshi Zhang Kegong and thirty-seven others passed and were granted degrees.
translations.idiomatic: At the palace examination jinshi Zhang Kegong and thirty-seven others passed and were granted degrees.

sentences.zh: 八年春正月，宋遣陳堯佐、張群來賀。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Chen Yaozuo and Zhang Qun with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，鐵驪來貢。

translations.literal: On renxu day, Tieli came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Tieli came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 建景宗廟於中京。

translations.literal: Built Emperor Jingzong temple at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jingzong's temple was built at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 封沙州節度使曹順為敦煌郡王。

translations.literal: Enfeoffed Shazhou military commissioner Cao Shun as Prince of Dunhuang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Shazhou military commissioner Cao Shun was enfeoffed as Prince of Dunhuang commandery.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，以前南院樞密使韓制心為中京留守，漢人行宮都部署王繼忠南院樞密使。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingwei day, made former Southern Privy Commissioner Han Zhixin Central Capital regent and Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Wang Jizhong Southern Privy Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day of the second month former Southern Privy Commissioner Han Zhixin was made Central Capital regent and Han Chinese palace metropolitan garrison commander Wang Jizhong Southern Privy Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，祭風伯。

translations.literal: On bingchen day, sacrificed to the Wind Lord.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day sacrifice was offered to the Wind Lord.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，以契丹弘義宮使赫石為興聖宮都部署，前遙恩拈部節度使控骨裏積慶宮都部署，左祗候郎君耶律罕四捷軍都監。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei day, made Khitan Hongyi Palace commissioner Heshi Xingsheng Palace metropolitan garrison commander, former Yao'en nian tribal military commissioner Kongguli Jiqing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, and Left attendant langjun Yelü Han Fourth Victory Army inspector general.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the third month Khitan Hongyi Palace commissioner Heshi was made Xingsheng Palace metropolitan garrison commander, former Yao'en nian tribal military commissioner Kongguli Jiqing Palace metropolitan garrison commander, and Left attendant langjun Yelü Han Fourth Victory Army inspector general.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，東平王蕭韓寧、東京留守耶律八哥、國舅平章事蕭排押、林牙要只等討高麗還，坐失律，數其罪而釋之。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; they were charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated, and they were released.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Eastern Capital Prince Xiao Hanning, Eastern Capital regent Yelü Bage, imperial uncle-in-law Associate Grand Chancellor Xiao Paiya, linya Yaozhi, and others returned from the Goryeo campaign; charged with violating military discipline, their crimes were enumerated and they were released.

sentences.zh: 己卯，詔加征高麗有功渤海將校官。

translations.literal: On jimao day, edict added ranks for Bohai officers who had merit in the Goryeo campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day an edict added ranks for Bohai officers who had merit in the Goryeo campaign.

sentences.zh: 壬午，閱飛龍院馬。

translations.literal: On renwu day, inspected Flying Dragon Court horses.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the Flying Dragon Court horses were inspected.

sentences.zh: 癸未，回跋部太師踏剌葛來貢。

translations.literal: On guiwei day, Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Talage came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Talage came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，置東京渤海承奉官都知押班。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, established Eastern Capital Bohai attendance officer metropolitan director and ranking supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Eastern Capital Bohai attendance officer metropolitan director and ranking supervisor was established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊子朔，如緬山。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the wuzi new moon, went to Mian Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the fourth summer month the court went to Mian Mountain.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，以駙馬蕭克忠為長寧軍節度使。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on renshen day, made imperial son-in-law Xiao Kezhong Changning Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day of the fifth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Kezhong was appointed Changning Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遷寧州渤海戶於遼、土二河之間。

translations.literal: On yihai day, relocated Ning Prefecture Bohai households between the Liao and Tu rivers.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Ning Prefecture Bohai households were relocated between the Liao and Tu rivers.

sentences.zh: 己卯，曷蘇館惕隱阿不葛、宰相賽剌來貢。

translations.literal: On jimao day, Hesuguan tiyin Abuge and chancellor Saila came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Hesuguan tiyin Abuge and chancellor Saila came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，錄征高麗戰歿將校子弟。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, enrolled children of officers who died in the Goryeo campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day of the sixth month children of officers who died in the Goryeo campaign were enrolled.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以左夷離畢蕭解裏為西南面招討使，御史大夫蕭要只為夷離畢。

translations.literal: On jichou day, made Left yilibi Xiao Jieli Southwestern Pacification commissioner and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yaozhi yilibi.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day Left yilibi Xiao Jieli was appointed Southwestern Pacification commissioner and Censor-in-Chief Xiao Yaozhi yilibi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，惕隱耶律合葛為南府宰相，南面林牙耶律韓留為惕隱。

translations.literal: On yihai day, made tiyin Yelü Hege Southern Chancellery chancellor and Southern linya Yelü Hanliu tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day tiyin Yelü Hege was made Southern Chancellery chancellor and Southern linya Yelü Hanliu tiyin.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，弛大擺山猿嶺采木之禁。

translations.literal: On guimao day, relaxed the prohibition on timber harvesting at Dabai Mountain and Yuanling.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the prohibition on timber harvesting at Dabai Mountain and Yuanling was relaxed.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以南皮室軍校等討高麗有功，賜金帛有差。

translations.literal: On yisi day, because Southern Pishi Army officers and others had merit campaigning against Goryeo, granted gold and silk with distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Southern Pishi Army officers and others were granted gold and silk in varying amounts for merit in the Goryeo campaign.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，征高麗戰歿諸將，詔益封其妻。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on jiwei day, for generals who died campaigning against Goryeo, edict increased enfeoffments for their wives.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the seventh autumn month an edict increased enfeoffments for the wives of generals who died in the Goryeo campaign.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以東北路詳穩耶律獨叠為北院大王。

translations.literal: On gengshen day, made Northeastern Route xiangwen Yelü Dujie Northern Chancellery Great King.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Northeastern Route xiangwen Yelü Dujie was made Northern Chancellery Great King.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，肴裏、涅哥二奚軍征高麗有功，皆賜金帛。

translations.literal: On xinyou day, the Yaoli and Niege two Xi armies had merit in the Goryeo campaign; all were granted gold and silk.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Yaoli and Niege Xi armies were granted gold and silk for merit in the Goryeo campaign.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，詔阻卜依舊歲貢馬千七百，駝四百四十，貂鼠皮萬、青鼠皮二萬五千。

translations.literal: On guihai day, edict ordered Zubu to continue yearly tribute of one thousand seven hundred horses, four hundred forty camels, ten thousand sable-mouse pelts, and twenty-five thousand blue-mouse pelts.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict ordered Zubu to continue yearly tribute of one thousand seven hundred horses, four hundred forty camels, ten thousand sable-mouse pelts, and twenty-five thousand blue-mouse pelts.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，觀稼。

translations.literal: On wuchen day, inspected crops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day the court inspected the crops.

sentences.zh: 己巳，回跋部太保麻門來貢。

translations.literal: On jisi day, Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Mamne came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Huiba tribal Grand Guardian Mamne came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，觀市，曲赦市中系囚。

translations.literal: On gengwu day, inspected the market and granted partial amnesty to prisoners held in the market.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the court inspected the market and granted partial amnesty to prisoners held there.

sentences.zh: 命解寧、馬翼充賀宋生辰使副。

translations.literal: Appointed Jiening and Ma Yi as chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Jiening and Ma Yi were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，遣郎君曷不呂等率諸部兵會大軍討高麗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengyin day, dispatched langjun Hebulu and others to lead various tribal troops to join the main army against Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day of the eighth month langjun Hebulu and others were dispatched to lead various tribal troops to join the main army against Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，以石用中參知政事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi day, made Shi Yongzhong Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day of the ninth month Shi Yongzhong was appointed Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 宋遣崔遵度、王應昌來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: Song sent Cui Zundu and Wang Yingchang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent Cui Zundu and Wang Yingchang to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 壬申，錄囚。

translations.literal: On renshen day, reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，復錄囚。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day, again reviewed prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day prisoners were reviewed again.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，曷蘇館惕隱阿不割來貢。

translations.literal: On gengchen day, Hesuguan tiyin Abugo came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Hesuguan tiyin Abugo came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 壬午，駐蹕土河川。

translations.literal: On renwu day, halted at Tuhe River valley.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the court encamped at Tuhe River valley.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙酉，詔諸道，事無巨細，已斷者，每三月一次條奏。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on yiyou day, edict to all circuits that matters great and small already decided were to be reported itemized once every three months.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day of the tenth winter month an edict ordered all circuits to report decided matters great and small in itemized lists once every three months.

sentences.zh: 戊子，遣耶律繼崇、鄭玄瑕賀宋正旦。

translations.literal: On wuzi day, dispatched Yelü Jichong and Zheng Xuanxia to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Yelü Jichong and Zheng Xuanxia were dispatched to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔橫帳三房不得與卑小帳族為婚；

translations.literal: On guisi day, edict that the three horizontal-tent houses may not marry with low small-tent clans;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day an edict forbade the three horizontal-tent houses to marry with low small-tent clans;

sentences.zh: 凡嫁娶，必奏而後行。

translations.literal: all marriages must be memorialized before proceeding.
translations.idiomatic: all marriages had to be memorialized before proceeding.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前北院大王建福為阿紥割只。

translations.literal: On guimao day, made former Northern Chancellery Great King Jianfu azagazhi.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day former Northern Chancellery Great King Jianfu was made azagazhi.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，改東路耗裏太保城為咸州，建節以領之。

translations.literal: On jiachen day, changed Eastern Route Haoli Grand Guardian city to Xian Prefecture and established a military commission to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Eastern Route Haoli Grand Guardian city was renamed Xian Prefecture and a military commission was established to govern it.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，置雲州宣德縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiayin day, established Xuande County in Yun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day of the eleventh month Xuande County was established in Yun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，駐蹕中京。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on xinmao day, halted at the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day of the twelfth month the court encamped at the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以廣平郡王宗業為中京留守、大定尹，韓制心為惕隱。

translations.literal: On yisi day, made Prince of Guangping Zongye Central Capital regent and Dading intendant, and Han Zhixin tiyin.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Prince of Guangping Zongye was made Central Capital regent and Dading intendant, and Han Zhixin tiyin.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，高麗王詢遣使乞貢方物，詔納之。

translations.literal: On xinhai day, Goryeo King Xun dispatched envoys begging to submit tribute goods; edict accepted them.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Goryeo King Xun sent envoys asking to resume tribute; an edict accepted their submission.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，宋遣劉平、張元普來賀。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tonghe, in the first spring month Song sent Liu Ping and Zhang Yuanpu with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 二月，如鴛鴦濼。

translations.literal: In the second month, went to Yuanyang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the court went to Yuanyang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，耶律資忠使高麗還，王詢表請稱藩納貢，歸所留王人只剌裏。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on gengwu day, Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial requesting to call himself a vassal and submit tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day of the fifth month Yelü Zizhong returned from a mission to Goryeo; King Xun submitted a memorial asking to resume vassal status and tribute and to return the detained Liao envoy Zhilali.

sentences.zh: 只剌裏在高麗六年，忠節不屈，以為林牙。

translations.literal: Zhilali had been in Goryeo six years, maintained loyal integrity unyielding, and was made linya.
translations.idiomatic: Zhilali had spent six years in Goryeo with loyal integrity unbroken and was made linya.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣使釋王詢罪，並允其請。

translations.literal: On xinwei day, dispatched envoys to release King Xun from guilt and granted his request.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were dispatched to absolve King Xun and grant his request.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以耶律宗教檢校太傅，宗誨啟聖軍節度使，劉晟太子太傅，仍賜保節功臣。

translations.literal: On guiyou day, made Yelü Zongjiao Acting Grand Mentor, Zonghui Qisheng Army military commissioner, and Liu Sheng Crown Prince Grand Tutor, also granting the Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity title.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Yelü Zongjiao was made Acting Grand Mentor, Zonghui Qisheng Army military commissioner, and Liu Sheng Crown Prince Grand Tutor, and all were granted the Meritorious Subject Who Preserves Integrity title.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚戌朔，日有食之，詔以近臣代拜救日。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on the gengxu new moon, there was a solar eclipse; edict ordered close ministers to perform sun-rescue rites on the Emperor's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse; an edict ordered close ministers to perform sun-rescue rites on the Emperor's behalf.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，遣使賜沙州回鶻敦煌郡王曹順衣物。

translations.literal: On jiayin day, dispatched envoys to grant Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to grant Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun clothing.

sentences.zh: 以查剌、耿元吉、韓九、宋璋為來年賀宋生辰正旦使副。

translations.literal: Made Zhala, Geng Yuanji, Han Jiu, and Song Zhang chief and deputy envoys for the next year to congratulate Song on the birthday and New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: Zhala, Geng Yuanji, Han Jiu, and Song Zhang were appointed chief and deputy envoys for the following year to congratulate Song on the Emperor's birthday and New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，以駙馬蕭紹宗平章事。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on wuwu day, made imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong Associate Grand Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day of the ninth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed Associate Grand Chancellor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，文武百僚奉表上尊號，不許；

translations.literal: On dingmao day, civil and military hundred officials submitted a memorial offering an honorific title; not permitted;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the civil and military hundred officials submitted a memorial offering an honorific title; permission was refused;

sentences.zh: 表三上，乃從之。

translations.literal: submitted three times, then permitted.
translations.idiomatic: after three submissions permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，沙州回鶻敦煌郡王曹順遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On yihai day, Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun dispatched envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Shazhou Uyghur Prince of Dunhuang Cao Shun sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 括諸道漢民馬賜東征軍。

translations.literal: Requisitioned Han Chinese civilian horses from all circuits to grant the eastern expedition army.
translations.idiomatic: Han civilian horses from all circuits were requisitioned for the eastern expedition army.

sentences.zh: 以夷離畢延寧為兵馬副都部署，總兵東征。

translations.literal: Made yilibi Yanning vice metropolitan horses-and-army garrison commander to command troops on the eastern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Yilibi Yanning was appointed vice metropolitan horses-and-army garrison commander to command the eastern expedition.

sentences.zh: 是月，駐蹕金瓶濼。

translations.literal: That month, halted at Jinping Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Jinping Marsh.

sentences.zh: 宋遣宋綬、駱繼倫賀千齡節。

translations.literal: Song sent Song Shou and Luo Jilun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent Song Shou and Luo Jilun to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊寅朔，以涅裏為奚王都監，突叠裏為北王府舍利軍詳穩。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on the wuyin new moon, made Nieli Xi King inspector general and Tudieli Northern Prince's House Sheli Army xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin new moon of the tenth winter month Nieli was made Xi King inspector general and Tudieli Northern Prince's House Sheli Army xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 郎君老使沙州還，詔釋宿累。

translations.literal: Langjun Lao, envoy to Shazhou, returned; an edict pardoned his accumulated punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Langjun Lao, envoy to Shazhou, returned, and an edict pardoned his accumulated punishments.

sentences.zh: 國家舊使遠國，多用犯徒罪而有才略者，使還，即除其罪。

translations.literal: By old custom when dispatching envoys to distant states, the state often used convicts who possessed talent and ability; when they returned, their crimes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: By old custom when the state dispatched envoys to distant countries it often chose convicts who possessed talent and ability; when they returned, their crimes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，西南招討奏党項部有宋犀族輸貢不時，常有他意，宜以時遣使督之。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the Southwestern Road pacification commissioner memorialized that among the Tangut tribes the Songxi clan had not delivered tribute on schedule and often harbored other intentions; envoys should be sent in season to supervise them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the Southwestern Road pacification commissioner reported that among the Tangut tribes the Songxi clan had not delivered tribute on schedule and often harbored other intentions, and that envoys should be sent in season to supervise them.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「邊鄙小族，歲有常貢。

translations.literal: An edict said: "The petty tribes on the frontier have annual fixed tribute.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "The petty tribes on the frontier owe annual fixed tribute.

sentences.zh: 邊臣驕縱，征斂無度，彼懷懼不能自達耳。

translations.literal: Frontier officials are arrogant and unrestrained, levying without limit; they harbor fear but cannot speak for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Frontier officials are arrogant and unrestrained and levy without limit; the tribes live in fear but cannot make themselves heard.

sentences.zh: 第遣清慎官將，示以恩信，無或侵漁，自然效順。

translations.literal: Just send upright and cautious officials and generals, show them favor and good faith, and let no one encroach or plunder, and they will naturally submit.
translations.idiomatic: Simply send upright and cautious officials and generals, show them favor and good faith, and let no one encroach or plunder, and they will naturally submit."

sentences.zh: 」復奏諦居、叠烈德部言節度使韓留有惠政，今當代，請留。

translations.literal: They again memorialized that the Diju and Dieliede tribes said pacification commissioner Han Liu had benevolent governance and his term was now ending; they requested he be retained.
translations.idiomatic: They again reported that the Diju and Dieliede tribes said pacification commissioner Han Liu had governed benevolently and his term was now ending, and asked that he be retained.

sentences.zh: 上命進其治狀。

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered his governance record submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered his record of governance submitted.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，如中京。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the court went to the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the court went to the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，大食國遣使進象及方物，為子冊割請婚。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Dashi state sent envoys presenting an elephant and regional products, requesting a marriage alliance on behalf of the prince Zicege.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Dashi state sent envoys presenting an elephant and regional products and requesting a marriage alliance on behalf of Prince Zicege.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，以漆水郡王韓制心為南京留守、析津尹、兵馬都總管。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingsi day Qishui Commandery King Han Zhixin was made Nanjing regent, Xijin intendant, and supreme commander of troops and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day of the eleventh month Qishui Commandery King Han Zhixin was appointed Nanjing regent, Xijin intendant, and supreme commander of troops and horses.

sentences.zh: 己未，以夷離畢蕭孝順為南面諸行宮都部署，加左僕射。

translations.literal: On jiwei day yilibi Xiao Xiaoshun was made supreme commander of all Southern Route mobile palaces and promoted to Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day yilibi Xiao Xiaoshun was made supreme commander of all Southern Route mobile palaces and promoted to Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，禁僧燃身煉指。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on dinghai day burning of the body and charring of fingers by monks was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day of the twelfth month monks were forbidden to burn their bodies or char their fingers.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔中京建太祖廟，制度、祭器皆從古制。

translations.literal: On wuzi day an edict ordered construction of the Taizu temple at the Central Capital, with regulations and ritual vessels all following ancient standards.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict ordered construction of the Taizu temple at the Central Capital, with regulations and ritual vessels all following ancient standards.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，詔來年冬行大冊禮。

translations.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered that the great enfeoffment rite be performed the coming winter.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered that the great enfeoffment rite be performed the coming winter.

sentences.zh: 放進士張仲舉等四十五人。

translations.literal: Jinshi Zhang Zhongju and forty-five others passed the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Jinshi Zhang Zhongju and forty-five others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 太平元年春正月丁丑朔，宋使魯宗道、成吉來賀。

translations.literal: First year of Taiping, spring, first month, on the dingchou new moon Song envoys Lu Zongdao and Cheng Ji came to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Taiping, on the dingchou new moon of the first spring month Song envoys Lu Zongdao and Cheng Ji came to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 如渾河。

translations.literal: The court went to the Hun River.
translations.idiomatic: The court went to the Hun River.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，幸鈸河。

translations.literal: Second month, on yimao day the court visited the Bo River.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the second month the court visited the Bo River.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，獵高柳林。

translations.literal: On renxu day hunted at Gaoliu Forest.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the court hunted at Gaoliu Forest.

sentences.zh: 三月戊戌，皇子勃已只生。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuxu day Prince Boyizhi was born.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day of the third month Prince Boyizhi was born.

sentences.zh: 庚子，駙馬都尉蕭紹業建私城，賜名睦州，軍曰長慶。

translations.literal: On gengzi day imperial son-in-law Commandant Xiao Shaoye built a private walled town; it was granted the name Muzhou, army designation Changqing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day imperial son-in-law Commandant Xiao Shaoye built a private walled town that was granted the name Muzhou, with army designation Changqing.

sentences.zh: 是月，大食國王復遣使請婚，封王子班郎君胡思裏女可老為公主，嫁之。

translations.literal: That month the King of Dashi again sent envoys requesting marriage; Prince Banlangjun Husili's daughter Kelao was enfeoffed as princess and married to him.
translations.idiomatic: That month the King of Dashi again sent envoys requesting marriage; Prince Banlangjun Husili's daughter Kelao was enfeoffed as princess and married to him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，東京留守奏，女直三十部酋長請各以其子詣闕祗候。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on wushen day the Eastern Capital regent memorialized that chiefs of thirty Jurchen tribes each requested to send their sons to the court to wait on attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the fourth summer month the Eastern Capital regent reported that chiefs of thirty Jurchen tribes each asked to send their sons to the court to wait on attendance.

sentences.zh: 詔與其父俱來受約。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them to come with their fathers to receive covenant.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered them to come with their fathers to receive covenant.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，錄囚。

translations.literal: On yimao day prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，置來州，是月，清暑緬山。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Laizhou was established; that month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Laizhou was established; that month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌朔，賜從獵女直人秋衣。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the jiaxu new moon Jurchen who had accompanied the hunts were granted autumn garments.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu new moon of the seventh autumn month Jurchen who had accompanied the hunts were granted autumn garments.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，遣骨裏取石晉所上玉璽於中京。

translations.literal: On yihai day Guli was dispatched to retrieve the jade seal that Later Jin had presented, from the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Guli was sent to retrieve from the Central Capital the jade seal that Later Jin had presented.

sentences.zh: 阻卜來貢。

translations.literal: The Zubu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Zubu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，如沙嶺。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the court went to Shaling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the court went to Shaling.

sentences.zh: 是月，獵潢河。

translations.literal: That month hunted on the Huang River.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court hunted on the Huang River.

sentences.zh: 九月，幸中京。

translations.literal: Ninth month, the court visited the Central Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the court visited the Central Capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，敵烈酋長頗白來貢馬、駝。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on dingwei day Dilie chief Pobai came with tribute of horses and camels.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day of the tenth winter month Dilie chief Pobai came with tribute of horses and camels.

sentences.zh: 戊申，錄囚。

translations.literal: On wushen day prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the court reviewed prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬子，宋使李懿、王仲賓來賀千齡節，及蘇惟甫、周鼎賀來歲元正，即遣蕭善、程翥報聘。

translations.literal: On renzi day Song envoys Li Yi and Wang Zhongbin came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival, and Su Weifu and Zhou Ding to congratulate the coming New Year's Day; envoys Xiao Shan and Cheng Zhu were immediately dispatched on a return mission.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Song envoys Li Yi and Wang Zhongbin came to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival and Su Weifu and Zhou Ding to congratulate the coming New Year's Day; Xiao Shan and Cheng Zhu were immediately sent on a return mission.

sentences.zh: 党項長曷魯來貢。

translations.literal: Tangut chief Helu came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Tangut chief Helu came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己未，以薩敏解裏為都點檢，高六副點檢，耶律羅漢奴左皮室詳穩，嗓姑右皮室詳穩，聊了西北路金吾，耶律僧隱御史大夫，求哥駙馬都尉，蕭舂、骨裏並大將軍。

translations.literal: On jiwei day Sa Minjieli was made supreme inspector, Gao Liu deputy inspector, Yelü Luohannu Left Pishi xiangwen, Sanggu Right Pishi xiangwen, Liaoliao Northwestern Route jinwu, Yelü Shengyin Censor-in-Chief, Qiuge Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law, and Xiao Chun and Guli both made great generals.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day Sa Minjieli was appointed supreme inspector, Gao Liu deputy inspector, Yelü Luohannu Left Pishi xiangwen, Sanggu Right Pishi xiangwen, Liaoliao Northwestern Route jinwu, Yelü Shengyin Censor-in-Chief, and Qiuge Commandant of the Imperial Son-in-law; Xiao Chun and Guli were both made great generals.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸通天觀，觀魚龍曼衍之戲。

translations.literal: On gengshen day the court visited Tongtian Observatory to watch dragon-and-fish aquatic performances.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the court visited Tongtian Observatory to watch dragon-and-fish aquatic performances.

sentences.zh: 翌日，再幸。

translations.literal: The next day the court visited again.
translations.idiomatic: The next day the court visited again.

sentences.zh: 還，升玉輅，自內三門入萬壽殿，奠酒七廟御容，因宴宗室。

translations.literal: Returning, the Emperor ascended the jade carriage, entered Wanshou Hall through the inner three gates, offered wine before the imperial portraits of the seven temples, and then feasted the imperial clan.
translations.idiomatic: On returning the Emperor ascended the jade carriage, entered Wanshou Hall through the inner three gates, offered wine before the imperial portraits of the seven temples, and then feasted the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸未，上御昭慶殿，文武百僚奉冊上尊號曰睿文英武遵道至德崇仁廣孝功成治定昭聖神贊天輔皇帝，大赦，改元太平，中外官進級有差。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on guiwei day the Emperor presided at Zhaqing Hall; civil and military officials presented the register and bestowed the honorific Sagaciously Cultured, Heroically Martial, Conforming to the Way, Utmost Virtue, Reverently Humane, Broadly Filial, Meritoriously Accomplished, Governingly Settled, Brilliantly Sage, Spiritually Praised, Heaven-Assisted Emperor; a grand amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed to Taiping, and officials at home and abroad were promoted in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day of the eleventh month the Emperor presided at Zhaqing Hall; civil and military officials presented the register and bestowed the honorific Sagaciously Cultured, Heroically Martial, Conforming to the Way, Utmost Virtue, Reverently Humane, Broadly Filial, Meritoriously Accomplished, Governingly Settled, Brilliantly Sage, Spiritually Praised, Heaven-Assisted Emperor; a grand amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed to Taiping, and officials at home and abroad were promoted in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 宋遣使來聘，夏、高麗遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Song dispatched envoys on a goodwill mission; Xia and Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Song dispatched envoys on a goodwill mission, and Xia and Goryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲申，冊皇子梁王宗真為皇太子。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Prince of Liang Zongzhen was invested as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Liang Zongzhen was invested as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月，如納水釣魚。

translations.literal: Second year, spring, first month, the court fished at Nashui.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, during the first spring month, the court fished at Nashui.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑朔，駐蹕魚兒濼。

translations.literal: Second month, on the xinchou new moon encamped at Yu'er Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou new moon of the second month the court encamped at Yu'er Marsh.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，如長春州。

translations.literal: Third month, on jiaxu day the court went to Changchun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day of the third month the court went to Changchun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，宋使薛貽廓來告宋主恒殂，子禎嗣位。

translations.literal: On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Zhen had died and his son Zhen had succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Song envoy Xue Yikuo came announcing that Song Emperor Zhen had died and his son Zhen had succeeded.

sentences.zh: 遣都點檢耶律僧隱等充宋祭奠使副，林牙蕭日新、觀察馮延休充宋後吊慰使副。

translations.literal: Supreme inspector Yelü Shengyin and others were dispatched as Song mourning sacrifice envoys; linya Xiao Rixin and inspection commissioner Feng Yanxiu as Song post-funeral condolence envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Supreme inspector Yelü Shengyin and others were sent as Song mourning sacrifice envoys, and linya Xiao Rixin and inspection commissioner Feng Yanxiu as Song post-funeral condolence envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，遣金吾耶律諧領、引進姚居信充宋主吊慰使副。

translations.literal: On wuyin day jinwu Yelü Xieling and introducing commissioner Yao Juxin were dispatched as envoys to condole on the late Song emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day jinwu Yelü Xieling and introducing commissioner Yao Juxin were sent as envoys to condole on the late Song emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，為宋主飯三京僧。

translations.literal: On wuzi day monks in the three capitals were fed on behalf of the late Song emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day monks in the three capitals were fed on behalf of the late Song emperor.

sentences.zh: 是月，地震，雲、應二州屋摧地陷，嵬白山裂數百步，泉湧成流。

translations.literal: That month an earthquake struck; in Yun and Ying prefectures houses collapsed and ground sank; Mount Weibai split for several hundred paces and springs gushed forth into streams.
translations.idiomatic: That month an earthquake struck; in Yun and Ying prefectures houses collapsed and the ground sank; Mount Weibai split for several hundred paces and springs gushed forth into streams.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，如緬山清暑。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month the court went to Mianshan for the summer retreat.

sentences.zh: 五月乙亥，參知政事石用中薨。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yihai day Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Shi Yongzhong died.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day of the fifth month Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Shi Yongzhong died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，鐵驪遣使獻兀惹十六戶。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Iron Li sent envoys presenting sixteen Wurang households.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Iron Li sent envoys presenting sixteen Wurang households.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，宋遣使薛由等來饋其先帝遺物。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiwei day Song sent envoys including Xue You bearing keepsakes of the late emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the sixth month Song sent envoys including Xue You bearing keepsakes of the late emperor.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以耶律信寧為奉陵軍節度使，高麗國參知政事王同顯靜海軍節度使，耶律遂忠長寧軍節度使，耿延毅昭德軍節度使，高守貞河西軍節度使。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yimao day Yelü Xinning was made military commissioner of the Fengling Army, Goryeo Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wang Tongxian military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Yelü Suizhong military commissioner of the Changning Army, Geng Yanji military commissioner of the Zhaode Army, and Gao Shouzhen military commissioner of the Hexi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the seventh autumn month Yelü Xinning was appointed military commissioner of the Fengling Army, Goryeo Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wang Tongxian military commissioner of the Jinghai Army, Yelü Suizhong military commissioner of the Changning Army, Geng Yanji military commissioner of the Zhaode Army, and Gao Shouzhen military commissioner of the Hexi Army.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，遣尚書僧隱、韓格賀宋主即位。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on guisi day Minister Yelü Shengyin and Han Ge were dispatched to congratulate the Song emperor on his accession.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day of the ninth month Minister Yelü Shengyin and Han Ge were sent to congratulate the Song emperor on his accession.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，遣堂後官張克恭充賀夏國王李德昭生日使，耶律掃古、韓王充賀宋太后生日使副，耶律仙寧、史克忠充賀宋正旦使副。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin day palace rear official Zhang Kegong was dispatched as envoy to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang as envoys to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day of the tenth winter month palace rear official Zhang Kegong was sent to congratulate Western Xia King Li Dezhao on his birthday; Yelü Saogu and Han Wang to congratulate the Song empress dowager on her birthday; and Yelü Xianning and Shi Kezhong to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 是月，駐蹕胡魯古思澱。

translations.literal: That month encamped at Hulugusi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court encamped at Hulugusi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，賜宰臣呂德懋、參知政事吳叔達、樞密副使楊又玄、右丞相馬保忠錢物有差。

translations.literal: On guimao day Chief Minister Lü Demao, Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda, Privy Council Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan, and Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong were granted money and goods in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Chief Minister Lü Demao, Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner Wu Shuda, Privy Council Vice Commissioner Yang Youxuan, and Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong were granted money and goods in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，至上京，曲赦畿內囚。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the court reached the Upper Capital and proclaimed a limited amnesty for prisoners within the capital district.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court reached the Upper Capital and proclaimed a limited amnesty for prisoners within the capital district.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，宋遣使來謝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on bingxu day Song dispatched envoys to express thanks.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the eleventh month Song sent envoys to express thanks.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛丑，高麗王詢薨，其子欽遣使來報，即命使冊欽為高麗國王。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinchou day Goryeo King Xun died; his son Qin sent envoys to report it, and envoys were immediately ordered to invest Qin as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day of the twelfth month Goryeo King Xun died; his son Qin sent envoys to report it, and envoys were immediately ordered to invest Qin as King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，宋遣劉燁、郭誌言來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Song sent Liu Ye and Guo Zhiyan to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Song sent Liu Ye and Guo Zhiyan to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士張漸等四十七人。

translations.literal: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and forty-seven others passed the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and forty-seven others passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅朔，如納水釣魚。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, on the bingyin new moon the court fished at Nashui.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on the bingyin new moon of the first spring month the court fished at Nashui.

sentences.zh: 以僧隱為平章事。

translations.literal: Yelü Shengyin was made Political Affairs Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Shengyin was appointed Political Affairs Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以蕭臺德為南王府都監，林牙耶律信寧西北路招討都監。

translations.literal: On yihai day Xiao Taide was made Southern Palace supreme supervisor; linya Yelü Xinning Northwestern Route pacification supreme supervisor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Xiao Taide was appointed Southern Palace supreme supervisor and linya Yelü Xinning Northwestern Route pacification supreme supervisor.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，賜越國公主私城之名曰懿州，軍曰慶懿。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the private walled town of the Princess of Yue was granted the name Yizhou, army designation Qingyi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the private walled town of the Princess of Yue was granted the name Yizhou, with army designation Qingyi.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，以丁振為武信軍節度使，改封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingshen day Ding Zhen was made military commissioner of the Wuxin Army and his fief was changed to Prince of Lanling Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the second month Ding Zhen was appointed military commissioner of the Wuxin Army and his fief was changed to Prince of Lanling Commandery.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以東平郡王蕭排押為西南面都招討，進封豳王。

translations.literal: On wushen day Eastern Plain Commandery King Xiao Paiya was made Southwestern Route supreme pacification commissioner and advanced to King of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Eastern Plain Commandery King Xiao Paiya was appointed Southwestern Route supreme pacification commissioner and advanced to King of Bin.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，以耶律守寧為都點檢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, Yelü Shouning was made supreme inspector.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth summer month Yelü Shouning was appointed supreme inspector.

sentences.zh: 五月，清暑緬山。

translations.literal: Fifth month, summer retreat at Mianshan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Mianshan.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，以南院宣徽使劉涇參知政事，蕭孝惠為副點檢，蕭孝恭東京統軍兼沿邊巡檢使。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wushen day Southern Court xuanhui commissioner Liu Jing was made associate administrative affairs commissioner; Xiao Xiaohui was made deputy inspector; Xiao Xiaogong was made Eastern Capital commander and concurrent frontier inspection commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day of the sixth month Southern Court xuanhui commissioner Liu Jing was appointed associate administrative affairs commissioner; Xiao Xiaohui was made deputy inspector; and Xiao Xiaogong was made Eastern Capital commander and concurrent frontier inspection commissioner.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以蕭璉為左夷離畢，蕭琳為詳穩。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Xiao Lian was made Left yilibi and Xiao Lin xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Xiao Lian was appointed Left yilibi and Xiao Lin xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊寅，以南府宰相耶律合葛為上京留守，封漆水郡王。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuyin day Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Hege was made Upper Capital regent and enfeoffed as Qishui Commandery King.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day of the seventh autumn month Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Hege was appointed Upper Capital regent and enfeoffed as Qishui Commandery King.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以皇后生辰為順天節。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the Empress's birthday was established as Shuntian Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the Empress's birthday was established as Shuntian Festival.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，賜緬山名曰永安。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Mianshan was granted the name Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Mianshan was granted the name Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 是月，獵赤山。

translations.literal: That month hunted at Chishan.
translations.idiomatic: That month the court hunted at Chishan.

sentences.zh: 閏九月壬辰朔，以蕭柏達、韓紹雍充賀宋正旦使副，唐骨德、程昭文賀宋生辰使副。

translations.literal: Intercalary ninth month, on the renchen new moon Xiao Baida and Han Shaoyong were dispatched as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day; Tang Gude and Cheng Zhaowen as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the intercalary ninth month Xiao Baida and Han Shaoyong were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day, and Tang Gude and Cheng Zhaowen as envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 冬十月庚辰，宋遣薛奎、郭盛來賀順天節，王臻、慕容惟素賀千齡節。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, on gengchen day Song sent Xue Kui and Guo Sheng to congratulate the Shuntian Festival, and Wang Zhen and Murong Weisu to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day of the tenth winter month Song sent Xue Kui and Guo Sheng to congratulate the Shuntian Festival and Wang Zhen and Murong Weisu to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 東征軍奏：「統帥諧領、常袞課奴率師自毛母國嶺入，林牙高九、裨將大匡逸等率師鼓山嶺入。

translations.literal: The Eastern Expedition Army reported: "Commander Xieling and Changgun Kenu led troops in from Maomuguo Ridge; linya Gao Jiu, subordinate general Da Kuangyi, and others led troops in from Gushan Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Expedition Army reported: "Commander Xieling and Changgun Kenu led troops in from Maomuguo Ridge, and linya Gao Jiu, subordinate general Da Kuangyi, and others led troops in from Gushan Ridge.

sentences.zh: 閏月未至撻離河，不遇敵而還。

translations.literal: Intercalary month they had not yet reached Talu River when they returned without encountering the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month they had not yet reached Talu River when they returned without encountering the enemy.

sentences.zh: 以是月會於弘怕只嶺，駝馬死者甚眾。

translations.literal: They rendezvoused at Hongpazhi Ridge that month, and very many camels and horses died.
translations.idiomatic: They rendezvoused at Hongpazhi Ridge that month, and very many camels and horses died."

sentences.zh: 」駐蹕遼河。

translations.literal: The court encamped on the Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: The court encamped on the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛卯朔，以皇侄宗範為歸德軍節度使，北府宰相蕭孝穆南京留守，封燕王，南京留守韓制心南院大王、兵馬都總管，仇正燕京轉運使。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on the xinmao new moon Imperial Nephew Zongfan was made military commissioner of the Guide Army; Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Xiaomu was made Nanjing regent and enfeoffed as King of Yan; Nanjing regent Han Zhixin was made Southern Court Great King and supreme commander of troops and horses; Qiu Zheng was made Yanjing transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinmao new moon of the eleventh month Imperial Nephew Zongfan was appointed military commissioner of the Guide Army; Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Xiaomu was made Nanjing regent and enfeoffed as King of Yan; Nanjing regent Han Zhixin was made Southern Court Great King and supreme commander of troops and horses; and Qiu Zheng was made Yanjing transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬戌，以宗範為平章事，封三韓郡王，仇道衡中京副留守，馮延休順州刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renxu day Zongfan was made Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Three Han Commandery; Qiu Daoheng was made Central Capital deputy regent; Feng Yanxiu was made prefect of Shunzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day of the twelfth month Zongfan was appointed Political Affairs Commissioner and enfeoffed as Prince of Three Han Commandery; Qiu Daoheng was made Central Capital deputy regent; and Feng Yanxiu was made prefect of Shunzhou.

sentences.zh: 郎玄化西山轉運使，趙其樞密直學士。

translations.literal: Lang Xuanhua was made Western Mountains transport commissioner and Zhao Qi Privy Direct Academician.
translations.idiomatic: Lang Xuanhua was appointed Western Mountains transport commissioner and Zhao Qi Privy Direct Academician.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以蕭永為太子太師。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Xiao Yong was made Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Xiao Yong was appointed Crown Prince Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 己卯，封皇子重元秦國王。

translations.literal: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Prince Chongyuan was enfeoffed as King of Qin.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月庚寅朔，宋遣張傳、張士禹、程琳、丁保衡來賀。

translations.literal: Fourth year, spring, first month, on the gengyin new moon Song sent Zhang Chuan, Zhang Shiyu, Cheng Lin, and Ding Baoheng to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, on the gengyin new moon of the first spring month Song sent Zhang Chuan, Zhang Shiyu, Cheng Lin, and Ding Baoheng to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 如鴨子河。

translations.literal: The court went to the Yazi River.
translations.idiomatic: The court went to the Yazi River.

sentences.zh: 二月己未朔，獵撻魯河。

translations.literal: Second month, on the jiwei new moon hunted on the Talu River.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiwei new moon of the second month the court hunted on the Talu River.

sentences.zh: 詔改鴨子河曰混同江，撻魯河曰長春河。

translations.literal: An edict renamed the Yazi River Huntun River and the Talu River Changchun River.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed the Yazi River Huntun River and the Talu River Changchun River.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，千齡節，詔賜諸宮分耆老食。

translations.literal: Third month, on the wuzi new moon, Thousand Age Festival; an edict granted food to elders in the various palace establishments.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi new moon of the third month, the Thousand Age Festival, an edict granted food to elders in the various palace establishments.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，以右丞相馬保忠之子世弘使嶺表，至平地松林，為盜所殺，特贈昭信軍節度使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on guiyou day Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong's son Shihong was sent on a mission beyond the passes; reaching Pingdi Pine Forest he was killed by bandits and was specially posthumously granted military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day of the fourth summer month Right Chancellor Ma Baozhong's son Shihong was sent on a mission beyond the passes; reaching Pingdi Pine Forest he was killed by bandits and was specially posthumously granted military commissioner of the Zhaoxin Army.

sentences.zh: 五月，清暑永安山。

translations.literal: Fifth month, summer retreat at Mount Yong'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Mount Yong'an.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，南院大王韓制心薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiwei day Southern Court Great King Han Zhixin died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day of the sixth month Southern Court Great King Han Zhixin died.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以鄭弘節為兵部郎中，劉慎行順義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On wuchen day Zheng Hongjie was made bureau director in the Ministry of War and Liu Shenxing military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Zheng Hongjie was appointed bureau director in the Ministry of War and Liu Shenxing military commissioner of the Shunyi Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以燕王蕭孝穆子順為千牛衛將軍。

translations.literal: On xinwei day made Yan King Xiao Xiaomu's son Shun Qianniu Guard general.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Yan King Xiao Xiaomu's son Shun was appointed general of the Qianniu Guard.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以中山郡王查哥為保靜軍節度使，樂安郡王遂哥廣德軍節度使，蕭解裏彰德軍節度使。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day made Prince of Zhongshan Commandery Zhage Baojing Army military commissioner, Prince of Le'an Commandery Suige Guangde Army military commissioner, and Xiao Jieli Zhangde Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Prince of Zhongshan Zhage was appointed military commissioner of the Baojing Army, Prince of Le'an Suige military commissioner of the Guangde Army, and Xiao Jieli military commissioner of the Zhangde Army.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以遼興軍節度使周王胡都古為臨海軍節度使，漆水郡王敵烈南院大王。

translations.literal: On gengchen day made Liaoxing Army military commissioner Prince Zhou Hu Dugu Linhai Army military commissioner, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie Southern Court great king.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince Zhou Hu Dugu was transferred from the Liaoxing Army to the Linhai Army, and Qishui Commandery Prince Di Lie was appointed Southern Court great king.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，如秋山。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, favored and visited Autumn Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh autumn month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰朔，以韓紹芳為樞密直學士，駙馬蕭匹敵都點檢。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on bingchen new moon, made Han Shaofang Privy Council direct scholar, and imperial son-in-law Xiao Pidi chief inspector.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen new moon of the eighth month Han Shaofang was appointed Privy Council direct scholar and imperial son-in-law Xiao Pidi chief inspector.

sentences.zh: 九月，以駙馬蕭紹宗為武定軍節度使，耶律宗福安國軍節度使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, made imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong Wuding Army military commissioner, and Yelü Zongfu An'guo Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month imperial son-in-law Xiao Shaozong was appointed military commissioner of the Wuding Army and Yelü Zongfu military commissioner of the An'guo Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，駐蹕遼河。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, imperial halt at Liao River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court encamped at the Liao River.

sentences.zh: 宋遣蔡齊、李用和來賀千齡節。

translations.literal: Song dispatched Cai Qi and Li Yonghe to come congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.
translations.idiomatic: Song sent Cai Qi and Li Yonghe to congratulate the Thousand Age Festival.

sentences.zh: 十一月，追封南院大王韓制心為陳王。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, posthumously enfeoffed Southern Court great king Han Zhixin as King of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Southern Court great king Han Zhixin was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chen.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以蕭從政為歸義軍節度使，康筠監門衛，充賀宋正旦使副。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, made Xiao Congzheng Guiyi Army military commissioner, Kang Jun Gate Guard, serving as deputy envoy to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Xiao Congzheng was appointed military commissioner of the Guiyi Army and Kang Jun, gate guard, was made deputy envoy to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.

sentences.zh: 是年，放進士李訁恣等四十七人。

translations.literal: That year, jinshi Li Zisi and forty-seven others were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Zisi and forty-seven others passed the examinations.
